productTypes.name: Bag
productTypes.prompt: The product is a handmade bag. It must be held or carried naturally: correct hand grip, realistic strap, handle and chain behaviour, true size relative to the body.

productTypes.name: Accessory
productTypes.prompt: The product is a handmade accessory (for example earrings). Show it clearly and in sharp focus; when worn, place it correctly and at true scale.

productTypes.name: Clothing
productTypes.prompt: The product is a handmade clothing piece. Keep its exact cut, length, fit, pattern, embroidery and colours.

styles.name: Studio
styles.prompt: Professional studio fashion photo on a solid seamless backdrop of {background}. Soft, even, diffused light with a subtle natural shadow. Clean, minimal, high-end e-commerce look.

styles.name: Lifestyle
styles.prompt: Natural lifestyle photo with a casual, real-photo feel, as if shot on a good camera by a friend. Setting: {scene}. Natural daylight, soft background blur.
